system.description: You've built a level 3 automaton follower. It otherwise functions much like your level 2 automaton from Automaton Assistant. Instead of gaining a new level 3 automaton, you can upgrade an existing level 2 or 3 automaton follower (increasing its level by 1) and gain a new level 2 automaton. You can take this ability multiple times, each time gaining another automaton.
